sourceLine: your StockyardViz and InDI twins, your mine safety work, and the questions operators ask before they fund a twin

cards.title: What Makes a Stockyard Twin Trustworthy
cards.angle: Around 90 percent of surveyed miners are using or piloting digital twins, and Datamine shipped one inside MineScape 2026 in March. Most twins are renders; a trustworthy one has a stated accuracy and a data path an operator can question.
cards.evidence: StockyardViz models stackers and reclaimers at 25 cm scale and your GRX26 page reports approximately 15 percent improvement in material-allocation efficiency in Q1 at an iron ore producer. Your FAQ already names the inputs (equipment positions, belt weightometers, lab assays, geometry); how they are calibrated, refreshed and reconciled when they arrive at different times is the engineering story.

sources.title: The optimisation of digital twins for mine safety

cards.title: Site Tourism Is the Twin ROI Nobody Models
cards.angle: Vendors sell twins on commissioning-time savings; the number a resource company can actually count is trips to a remote asset. A twin replaces a visit only once the information specialists needed on site is available remotely.
cards.evidence: Your InDI case reports an unnamed major resource company estimating savings upwards of AUD 3M a year, with remote round trips costing upwards of AUD 10,000 and first-months savings covering deployment, on a build that mapped data to DMS and ERP. Which visits became avoidable, and what had to be visible first, is the article.

cards.title: From Knowing Priority Rules to Using Them on Site
cards.angle: WA mineral industry fatalities fell to one in 2023-24 while lost-time injuries rose to 591. The numbers do not prove any training method; they do show that rule knowledge and rule use are different problems.
cards.evidence: Your Macmahon case did not replace classroom or field training; it added a VR mine-road module between them for repeated site-specific decisions, then checked those decisions under supervision. Your Barminco modules (2021) report zero pedestrian-to-vehicle incidents among 200-plus trainees; use it dated and attributed.
